instruction: Connect this document to a Git repository and enable version control tracking so every change is automatically committed with timestamps.

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in Git integration or automatic version control features. While the files can be manually tracked in Git repositories, there is no native Git integration within the application.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer lacks native Git integration or automatic version control capabilities
The instruction requires 'automatic' commits with timestamps, which is technically impossible within LibreOffice Writer
The infeasible() evaluator function is semantically appropriate for tasks that cannot be verified due to technical impossibility
Metadata explanation correctly identifies the technical limitations of the application
